headline: Sensex crashes 2,743 points at open, Nifty slips to 24,659; Rs 7.8 lakh crore wealth eroded - BusinessToday
summary: The BSE Sensex fell as much as 2,743.46 points to 78,543.73 at the open, while the NSE Nifty dropped 519.4 points to 24,659.25. About Rs 7.8 lakh crore in investor wealth was eroded.
why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmarks of Indian equities, tracking the largest listed companies on the BSE and NSE.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The benchmark index itself fell sharply at the open.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
